/* cppi::6736c8dee166230d79640ca1cc9a5073d2eb4c82b2f10fae35cebb704f489e1c */
select last_day_of_month(business_date) as business_date,
	currency_code,
    null vendor_code,
	avg(perusd_sr) as perusd_sr,
	avg(perusd_1m) as perusd_1m,
	avg(percad_sr) as percad_sr,
	avg(percad_1m) as percad_1m,
    max(arrival_time) as arrival_time
from
  (select business_date, currency_code, perusd_sr, perusd_1m, percad_sr, percad_1m, arrival_time,
   	row_number() over (partition by business_date, currency_code order by arrival_time desc) as rn
  from market.fx_rate
  where business_date between date '1982-08-31' and date '2025-04-01'
    and last_day_of_month(business_date) <= date '2025-04-01'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-04-01' ) as fx
where rn = 1
group by
	last_day_of_month(fx.business_date),
	currency_code

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 23 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 24 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-23 23:53:36'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 06:11:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc

	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-24')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-24')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-24')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

WITH
earliest_business_date_of_given_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(business_date) AS business_date
    FROM market_qa.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE rate_type_code = 'SR'
        AND MONTH(business_date) = MONTH(DATE('2025-06-24'))
        AND YEAR(business_date) = YEAR(DATE('2025-06-24'))
),
fx_rates_usd_to_cad AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_qa.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND to_currency = 'CAD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_usd_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        from_currency from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_qa.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_cad_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        usd_to_cl.business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        ROUND((usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate), 8) exchange_rate
    FROM
        (fx_rates_usd_to_local usd_to_cl
        INNER JOIN fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad ON (usd_to_cl.business_date = usd_to_cad.business_date))
    UNION
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        'USD' to_currency,
        exchange_rate exchange_rate
    FROM
        fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
)
SELECT
    business_date,
    from_currency,
    to_currency,
    exchange_rate
FROM fx_rates_cad_to_local
WHERE business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM earliest_business_date_of_given_month)

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 21:46:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	select

		lt.security_type_name,

	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug

SELECT aa.business_date,
                                aa.option_id,
                                aa.option_symbol,
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0 as strike,
                                aa.expiration_date,
                                aa.open_interest,
                                aa.call_put_flag,
                                aa.best_bid,
                                aa.best_ask,
                                aa.vega, 
                                bb.close_price as SpotRef, 
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa
                                join market.om_security_price bb
                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date
                        where
                            aa.security_id = 205681
                            AND aa.business_date >= DATE '2025-06-23'
                            AND aa.business_date <= DATE '2025-06-23'
                            AND date_diff('day', aa.business_date, aa.expiration_date) > 5
                            AND aa.best_bid > 0
                            AND aa.best_ask > 0
                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (
                                (aa.best_bid + aa.best_ask) / 2 >= CASE 
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)

                            )

/* cppi::e2d3dee313436107cfcfc6bfefa7aa1650ee71452a5190d653aed4a12a9ed355 */
SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','VEB','ZWG')

						)
					)
			    )

        OR currencyToCadRate is not Null

	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 09:21:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 02:10:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended l
left join holdings.scd_holdings_main m 
  on date(m.business_date)=l.business_date 
  and scd_holding_key_id=parent_holding_key
left join reference.scd_securities rs
  on rs.business_date=(select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
  and rs.abor_security_number = m.abor_security_number
left join reference.scd_securities undrs
  on rs.abor_underlying_instrument_id = undrs.scd_security_key_id
  and rs.business_date = undrs.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esmv
  on esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.enterprise_security_id = esmv.enterprise_security_id
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esmvp
  on esmvp.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.parent_cppib_sec_id = cast(esmvp.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite und_esmv
  on und_esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and und_esmv.abor_security_number = undrs.abor_security_number
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pc
  on l.business_date = pc.business_date
  and l.enterprise_party_id = pc.enterprise_party_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai1
  on ai1.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(ai1.cppib_sec_id as varchar)=l.cppib_sec_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai2
  on ai2.business_date=l.business_date
  and ai2.scd_id = l.Parent_Security_Name
left join party.party_gics_classifications pgc
  on pgc.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pgc.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
  and pgc.level=1
left join party.party p
  on p.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
left join party.party pp
  on pp.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pp.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esmvp.cppib_party_id
left join risk_prod.cppib_party_rating pr
  on date(pr.business_date)=l.business_date and pr.rating_agency= 'CPPIB'
  and l.cppib_party_id=cast(pr.cppib_party_id as varchar)
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pf
  on date(pf.business_date)=l.business_date
  and pf.model_portfolio = l.id_model_portfolio
  and pf.InvestmentStructure = (select max(distinct InvestmentStructure)
                                   from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
                                   where business_date = '2025-06-11'
                                   and InvestmentStructure like 'CPPIB_F%')
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
  on rcc.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.country_of_exposure_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio rmp
  on date(rmp.business_date)=l.business_date
  and rmp.model_portfolio_id = l.id_model_portfolio
left join reference.scd_party_issuer brk
  on date(brk.business_date)=l.business_date
  and brk.party_id = l.broker_code
  and brk.broker = 'Yes'
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
  on date(spi.business_date)=l.business_date
  and spi.party_id = rs.abor_issuer_id

               concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar),cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level != 'Look Through' THEN l.parent_security_number
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.cppib_sec_id != 'Not Applicable' THEN concat('CPP',l.cppib_sec_id)
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(l.parent_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      when m.abor_security_type_name='Equity Future' then concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      else coalesce(esmv.abor_security_number, concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar), cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))))
 end AS "Underlying_Security_No"

,case WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.esm_security_name,'-FutureOffset')
      else esmv.esm_security_name
 end AS "Underlying_Security_Name"

,case when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future','Equity Future') then p.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('IRS IR') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') then coalesce(p.party_name, spi.party_name)
      else pc.epm_party_name end AS "Underlying_Issuer_Name"

,m.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "FX_Rate"
,l.balance_nominal "Balance_Nominal"
,CASE WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN (
        'TRSEQ',
        'TRSEQIC',
        'CDS',
        'FXSPOT',
        'FXFORWARD',
        'FXNDF',
        'TRSFIIC',
        'FUT_BOND',
        'FUT_EQT',
        'FUT_IR',
        'IRS IR'
    )
     THEN l.total_market_value_pc 
     ELSE 0 END AS Leg_Exposure_PC 
,case when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC','IRS IR','FUT_IR','FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT')
        then coalesce(l.currency_of_exposure_code, l.parent_quoted_currency_code)

,rs.abor_instrument_type_id Parent_Instrument_Type_Name

     'Credit Default Swap'
     ) then
           date_format(date(und_esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
     when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future', 'TRS Fixed Income IC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 then

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null

WITH
latest_fx_rates AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_df3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_df2
),
latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                  AS asset_code,
           il_reporting_name                                 AS reporting_name,
           investment_name,
           investment_desc_il                                AS investment_description,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))              AS model_portfolio_id,
           CONCAT('RD', UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(asset_code), 2)))  AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           investment_type_il,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           market_type,
           country_region_il,
           reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count_il,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il,
           UPPER(df_status) = 'DRAFT'                                  AS is_draft
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL' and df_status is not null
),
latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.market_type,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ild.is_draft,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date           
),
latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value_base_currency
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM latest_yardi_deals
              )
      )
),
yardi_deals_normalized AS (
    SELECT asset_code                                                    AS investment_code,
           as_of_date                                                    AS as_of_date,
           business_date                                                 AS business_date,
           model_portfolio_id                                            AS model_portfolio_id,
           debt_model_portfolio_id                                       AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           investment_name                                               AS investment_name,
           investment_description                                        AS investment_description,
           investment_agg_il                                             AS investment_aggregate_name,
           reporting_name                                                AS reporting_name,
           investment_type_il                                            AS investment_type,
           allocation_name_il                                            AS allocation_name,
           country_exposure_il                                           AS country_of_exposure,
           currency_exposure_il                                          AS currency_of_exposure,
           country_region_il                                             AS country_or_region,
           market_type                                                   AS market_type,
           cppib_ownership_perc                                          AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
           il_governance_structure_level_1                               AS investment_structure,
           investment_stage_current_il                                   AS investment_stage,
           geographic_focus                                              AS geographic_focus,
           sector_focus_level_1_il                                       AS sector_focus,

           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_df3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_df2

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                  AS asset_code,
           il_reporting_name                                 AS reporting_name,
           investment_name,
           investment_desc_il                                AS investment_description,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))              AS model_portfolio_id,
           CONCAT('RD', UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(asset_code), 2)))  AS debt_model_portfolio_id,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           investment_type_il,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           market_type,
           country_region_il,
           reporting_currency_il,

           sector_focus_level_2_il,

           il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count_il,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il,
           UPPER(df_status) = 'DRAFT'                                  AS is_draft
      FROM real_assets_trusted_dev.yardi_dif_ifre_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL' and df_status is not null
),
latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.market_type,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ild.is_draft,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date           
),
latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value_base_currency
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM latest_yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

           temporary_roc_cad                                             AS temporary_roc_historical,
           permanent_roc_cad                                             AS permanent_roc_historical,
           net_invested_equity_base_currency                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,

           equity_carrying_value_base_currency                           AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           carrying_value_local_currency                                 AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           debt_carrying_value_local_currency                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           equity_carrying_value_local_currency                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           commitment_base_currency                                      AS commitment_base_currency,
           commitment_local_currency                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           allocation_base_currency                                      AS allocation_base_currency,
           allocation_local_currency                                     AS allocation_local_currency,

           occupied_area                                                 AS occupied_area,
           total_area                                                    AS total_area,
           is_draft                                                     AS is_draft

) 
  SELECT investment_code                                AS id,
         investment_code,
         model_portfolio_id,
         debt_model_portfolio_id,
         investment_name,
         reporting_name,
         investment_aggregate_name, -- new
         investment_description,
         as_of_date,
         business_date,
         investment_department,
         investment_group,
         business_unit,
         investment_type,
         investment_stage,
         investment_count,
         country_of_exposure,
         currency_of_exposure,
         country_or_region,
         market_type,
         allocation_name, -- new
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE cppib_ownership_percentage END AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
         investment_structure, -- new
         geographic_focus, -- new
         sector_focus,
         sub_sector_focus,
         local_reporting_currency,
         developed_emerging_country, -- new
         investment_manager,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE allocation                           END AS allocation,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE commitments                          END AS commitments,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE uncommitted_allocation               END AS uncommitted_allocation,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE gross_invested_equity                END AS gross_invested_equity,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE gross_invested_equity_historical     END AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE expenses_inside_commitment           END AS expenses_inside_commitment,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE capital_additions                    END AS capital_additions,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE temporary_roc                        END AS temporary_roc,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE temporary_roc_historical             END AS temporary_roc_historical,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE permanent_roc_historical             END AS permanent_roc_historical,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE invested_commitment                  END AS invested_commitment,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE unfunded_commitment                  END AS unfunded_commitment,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE unfunded_commitment_base_currency    END AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE unfunded_commitment_local_currency   END AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE exposure                             END AS exposure,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE occupied_area                        END AS occupied_area,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE total_area                           END AS total_area,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE carrying_value_base_currency         END AS carrying_value_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE carrying_value_local_currency        END AS carrying_value_local_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE debt_carrying_value_base_currency    END AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE debt_carrying_value_local_currency   END AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE equity_carrying_value_base_currency  END AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE equity_carrying_value_local_currency END AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE net_invested_equity_base_currency    END AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE net_invested_equity_local_currency   END AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE commitment_base_currency             END AS commitment_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE commitment_local_currency            END AS commitment_local_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE allocation_base_currency             END AS allocation_base_currency,
         CASE WHEN is_draft THEN NULL ELSE allocation_local_currency            END AS allocation_local_currency,
         is_draft
    FROM yardi_deals_normalized
    where is_draft is not null
    and business_date = date '2025-06-23'
    and investment_code= 'ialpha'

 FROM (

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 12:05:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::1f329ba70f6eba7a124cc417f58519895155764f85aeb3da11bbc4c03e740dec */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 18 and 19
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 18:30:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 21:03:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_var
where business_date = '2025-06-20'

) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-20' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node

left join

select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from

where business_date = '2025-06-20' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id

left join

SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation

    calc.sell_roc_pc, 
    calc.sell_cos_pc,

    calc.sell_roc_qc, 
    calc.sell_cos_qc,
    calc.sell_gl_qc,
    calc.gross_div_pc                                                                AS "Gross Dividend PC",
    calc.gross_div_qc                                                                AS "Gross Dividend QC",
    calc.div_taxes_pc                                                                AS "Dividend Taxes PC",
    calc.div_taxes_qc                                                                AS "Dividend Taxes QC",
    calc.net_purchase_qc                                                             AS "Net Purchase QC",
    calc.purchase_cost_qc                                                            AS "Purchase Cost QC",
    calc.net_purchase_pc                                                             AS "Net Purchase PC",
    calc.purchase_cost_pc                                                            AS "Purchase Cost PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_pc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc                                                                 AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc                                                                AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_qc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase QC",
    calc.net_sell_qc                                                                 AS "Net Sell QC",
    calc.total_cap_qc                                                                AS "Total Capital QC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_qc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance QC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id ) ds LIMIT 0

            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id

    calculated_trans AS(

                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),

        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),

                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,

        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id

    calculated_trans AS(

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,

        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 24
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24 09:56:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

FROM (select mhl.business_date,
	shm.portfolio_group_id,
	mhl.security_type_name,
	mhl.id_model_portfolio,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	smp.pool_account_name,

	mhl.parent_security_number as abor_security_number,
	es.security_name_id,
	es.sedol,
	es.bloomberg_cd,
	mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,

	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + 
		shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency + shm.next_coupon_quotation_currency + shm.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as total_accrued_income_qc,
	mhl.total_market_value_qc,
	mhl.total_market_value_pc,

		else mhl.total_market_value_pc * su.acpp_unitized_percentage
		end as acpp_total_market_value_pc,
	case when mhl.pool_name like 'bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		else mhl.total_market_value_pc * su.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		end as bcpp_total_market_value_pc,
	shm.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id,
	mhl.parent_security_number,
